name: Nová Dubnica (Slovakia)
description: Six equal horizontal stripes of yellow, red, yellow, red, yellow and red, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature N-5/1991.
